The lower bound is algebraic, while the matching upper bound follows from a proved Fourier-interval character-sum estimate and nonresidues within O(sqrt(p) log p) of the two target angles. Computations only corroborate finite cases; the analytic proof handles arbitrary primes and mask locations.

value.rationale: Integrated squared cyclic sidelobe energy is exactly the punctured discrete Fourier fourth-moment flatness deficit, a natural robustness metric for losing two reference symbols. The complete root-energy multiset is invariant under arbitrary two-erasure spacings (an exact arithmetic design principle), and optimization produces a sharp p modulo 4 transition with constant term and absolute o(1) error; this is not a known table lookup or automatic one-erasure corollary. Limitations are explicit: no peak-sidelobe or general code-family optimality.
